test_title: PYST 4: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight friends, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a round table facing its centre. P is in between R and S. T sits third to the left of W. Q is to the immediate left of S. T sits third to the right of S. V is between U and W. Who is sitting between S and W?
solution:
**Eight friends:** P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, and W.

(1) T sits third to the left of W. 

(2) T sits third to the right of S. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c65f543fa66e70f7024bd708b7d9a5364cd6078e85509333a6645c6cd3c529a9.png] 

(3) Q is to the immediate left of S. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03bef6e7b8abfdc9097ec69483666b47ffbd6d3e04a86afe65022bb7dde8c6e7.png] 

(4) V is between U and W. 

(5) P is in between R and S. Thus, the final seating arrangement is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0384a3013afe4b534d96a65e4aa8964a72fc355fc3bc4c320dafc1ffe192cc5b.png] 

Hence, **Q **is sitting between S and W.
